AGENDA

Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Asha Grant DBA The Salt Eaters Bookshop to host The Salt Eaters & Friends
  Neighborhood Block Party at 320 E. Queen Street, on Saturday, July 10, 2021, from

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #2:  Carmen Thomas DBA Prosperity Collective LLC to host a Juneteenth Pop Up
  Farmers Market Event at 333 W. Florence Ave, (Faith Central Bible Church Parking
  Lot) on Saturday, June 19, 2021, from 11:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m. (Activity No.00319501)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #3:  Derek Steele DBA Social Justice Learning Institute for- IUD & Woodland Records to

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #4:  Jennifer L. Talbert DBA G&M Oil Company, INC. to operate as a tobacco retailer at
